glosses: neediness, state of being in need

examples.text: Las necesidades de muchos pesan más que las de pocos.
examples.en: The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few.
I felt it was necessary to do it.

examples.text: Las personas tienden a subestimar sus necesidades futuras.
examples.en: People have a tendency to underestimate their future needs.

examples.text: No hay necesidad de tener miedo.
examples.en: There's no need to be afraid.
